crossRefs.note: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has…
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of…
‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father…
God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
